title: [SOLO] T-67: a report filed from the launch that follows a crash carries the crashed session's own ring log (bamp-ring-prev.log), even when it is not filed through the crash popup. The host plays, is killed (a real crash: no clean close), relaunches, and files a report through the 'bugreport' lever (the hand-filed path: includeCrashArtifacts=false).
preconditions: Rig configs' BugReportRelayUrl points at a dead local port (checked 2026-11-15), so no upload can reach the live relay. Fixture save1. Dev build with the 'bugreport' lever reporting afterUnclean/ringprev.
oracles_report: \[BugReport\] Previous session did not close cleanly

steps.note: SOLO: the client instance is closed first (it shares the bug-reports folder)
PREMISE: the live ring log is written to disk every ~10 s, so the session about to crash has one
a real crash: the game is killed with no clean close, so its session marker stays 'open'
